name: Nature’s Favor
body:
School evocation; Level druid 3, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target animal touched
Duration 1 minute/2 levels
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You call upon the power of nature and grant the touched animal a luck bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to 1/2 your caster level.
